businesses.business: home medical equipment and home healthcare supplies provider

offering_description.value: Provides home medical equipment, medical supplies and related services to patients in their homes, covering sleep apnea, diabetes, mobility, oxygen and respiratory therapy. Delivers through a network of local branches and delivery operations, billing insurers and government payors, and serves patients referred by physicians and hospitals.

primary_products.value: CPAP and sleep therapy devices and supplies; continuous glucose monitors and insulin pumps; home oxygen equipment; mobility devices and hospital beds; nebulizers and ventilators

primary_services.value: home delivery of medical equipment; patient setup and training; resupply programs; respiratory therapy services; insurance billing and patient support

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients using home medical equipment, billed mostly through insurance; B2B: referring physicians, hospitals, and commercial insurers and payors; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs as payors

end_markets.value: home healthcare; sleep apnea; diabetes care; respiratory care; mobility and chronic disease management

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: payments from Medicare, Medicaid and commercial insurers for equipment and supplies; rental or leasing: monthly rentals of oxygen concentrators, ventilators and hospital beds; product sales: recurring resupply of sleep and diabetes supplies
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; rental or leasing; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys equipment and supplies from manufacturers, delivers to patients and bills payors; distributor: purchases medical devices and supplies from manufacturers and sells or rents them to patients

geography_served.value: US national: Operates branches across most US states

specialization.value: related lines: sleep, diabetes, respiratory, mobility and other home medical equipment lines

distribution_channels.value: own locations: local branches and delivery operations serving patients; direct sales: referral-based sales via physicians, hospitals and health systems; online: patient ordering and resupply portals

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medicare and Medicaid reimbursement rules, CMS competitive bidding, FDA device rules, state licensing and HIPAA

divestiture_lines: P1.41: AdaptHealth Corp. Enters into Definitive Agreement to Divest Diabetes Health Business to Cardinal Health
